_doc: Repos that are DELIBERATELY local-only. remote-coverage-check.py fails on any remote-less repo NOT listed here. An entry is a recorded decision, not a mute button: it needs a reason someone can argue with, and 'unblock' means either pushing the repo or changing the reason. Never delete a repo to clear the gate.
_scar: 2026-07-29 audit: 12 remote-less repos found, oldest 219 commits. Some hold personal-sensitive data and must never get a hosted remote. An always-on auto-push would have published them, which is why creation is opt-in and this file exists.
_reason_discipline: THIS FILE IS COMMITTED TO A PUBLIC REPO. State the CLASS of sensitive content and the path that carries it, never the content itself. A reason that quotes the private data defeats the gate it documents. Detail belongs in the local-only repo, not here.

local_only.reason: Tracked files carry health + education records about a specific minor, re-identifying against the owner's public identity. Class: family-medical. Not pushable, private included, until that content moves to a gitignored path.
local_only.review: Re-decide once the carrier paths are gitignored. The canonical/ research corpus is general literature and would be pushable on its own.

local_only.reason: One tracked file carries health attributes, ages, and home city for minors. Class: family-medical. No names, and no card/passport/loyalty numbers (those are gitignored and verified never committed in full history), but the remaining combination is re-identifying.
local_only.review: A single line in the carrier file is the blocker. Move it to a gitignored private-notes.md and this repo becomes pushable private.

local_only.reason: Physically unpushable to GitHub: two tracked files exceed the 100MB hard limit (.venv-chatterbox torch libtorch_cpu.dylib 178MB, llvmlite 123MB). The venv is committed. Fixing it requires a history rewrite, which is a separate deliberate decision, not a side effect of this gate.
local_only.review: Needs the committed .venv-chatterbox purged from history before any push can succeed. Tracked as spillover.
